verdict.rationale: Wise documents that balance statements can be retrieved in several open and standard formats (JSON, CSV, XLSX, CAMT.053, MT940, QIF), so financial transaction data is exportable. Nothing shows a complete account-wide export or a documented exit path. Missing for 10: full-account export covering recipients, cards and profile data; a documented account closure/offboarding process; independent or hands-on corroboration of the export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Statements can be retrieved in multiple formats: JSON, CSV, PDF, XLSX, CAMT.053, MT940, or QIF.
